question: In April 2025, which IPL franchise became the first team to reach 150 victories in the history of the tournament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai Indians**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mumbai Indians (MI)** scripted history in **April 2025** by becoming the first franchise to record **150 victories** in the history of the **Indian Premier League (IPL)**.
 
• The milestone was achieved during a league match at their home ground, the iconic **Wankhede Stadium** in **Mumbai**.
 
• This tally of **150 wins** includes victories achieved across all seasons of the **IPL** since its inception in **2008**, excluding matches decided by Super Overs if counted as draws in official statistics, though generally, all format wins are aggregated for this milestone.
 
• **Mumbai Indians** was also the first team to reach the **100-win** milestone in the **IPL**, demonstrating their long-standing dominance in the tournament. ***Hence, the statement regarding Mumbai Indians is correct.***
 
• The franchise
